name: aria-knowledge-graph
description: Build and query Aria's knowledge graph. Store entities (people, places, concepts) and their relationships.
author: Aria Team

tools.name: add_entity
tools.description: Create or update an entity in the knowledge graph.

entity_type.description: Entity type (person, place, concept, event, organization, skill, topic)

tools.name: add_relation
tools.description: Create a relationship between two entities.

relation.description: Relationship type (created, owns, uses, knows, works_with, located_in, part_of, related_to, interested_in)

tools.name: query
tools.description: Find entities related to a given entity (BFS traversal), OR, if entity_name is omitted, list/filter entities by type/relation.

entity_name.description: Entity name to find relations for. Omit this to list entities instead (use entity_type/relation to filter).

entity_type.description: Filter by entity type, e.g. when listing entities without entity_name

tools.name: get_entities
tools.description: List/search multiple entities, optionally filtered by type. Use this to list several entities at once (for a single entity by name/id, use get_entity).

type.description: Filter by entity type (person, place, concept, event, organization, skill, topic)

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to return (default: 50)

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Search for and retrieve an entity by name or type.
